captured: after the redesign, on the live code
why: The redesign changed every colour on the site, moved the drawing palette
out of eight lab files and into one reader, converted the instrument
frame from dark to light, and rebuilt the navigation. None of that
should touch a number. This file is the evidence that it did not.
It is the same subject and the same procedure as crystal-before.json,
captured with the same harness, so the two are directly comparable.
procedure: prefers-reduced-motion forced, so the engine drives no frames and the readout stays at the seed radius. Set gravity, click replay, read the readout. This is the condition crystal-before.json was captured under.

g=1.000.verdict: Flow is winning. Fresh solution keeps arriving, so growth stays fast and the shell never builds.

g=0.010.verdict: Diffusion is winning. The shell has built up, growth is slowing itself down, and the crystal comes out even.

g=0.000.verdict: Diffusion is winning. The shell has built up, growth is slowing itself down, and the crystal comes out even.

againstBefore: Identical at all three gravities. Every one of the six readouts and all three verdicts match crystal-before.json exactly. The assumption list is still five items and the depth control still has three settings.

codeChars.note: crystal-before.json records 434. That difference is not from the redesign: it is from the earlier time scaling fix, which is the commit that removed the 1400 multiplier from dRdt before integration. The redesign did not edit any function in lab-crystal.js, only the six colour constants it draws with.

growthCurveInk_note: Non-zero, which is the thing growth-before.json was capturing when it found nought. Counted under reduced motion, where the run does not animate, so it is lower than the 822 that growth-after.json records for a full run at zero gravity and is not comparable to it. What it establishes is that the panel draws a curve rather than an empty box.
alsoChecked: All eighteen routes load with no console error, no failed request and no broken internal link, at 1280x900 and at 375x812, in light, in dark, and with reduced motion forced.
Every one of the eight framed instruments renders its traces legibly. Before this change six of the eight were drawing #332E5C on #0d0e11, which is about 1.7:1.
The search index count now matches map.js. build-search.py exits non-zero if it does not.
